newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGOLAISE BUYS 35% OF GHANA'S TRUST BANK.
newsitem.headline: BELGOLAISE BUYS 35% OF GHANA'S TRUST BANK.

text.p: Belgian bank Belgolaise SA said on Friday it had bought a 35.0 percent stake in Ghana's The Trust Bank Ltd (TTB) for undisclosed terms.
TTB was appointed by the Bank of Ghana in August 1995 to run the former Meridien BIAO Bank Ghana Ltd, part of the Meridien group of African banks which collapsed at the start of 1995.
TTB is the sixth former Meridien-BIAO bank in which Belgolaise has taken a large minority stake in the past year and a half.

Belgolaise said in its twice-monthly bulletin the other shareholders in TTB are: Ghana's National Insurance Trust (38.1 percent), Ghana Reinsurance Trust (5.9 percent), the Netherlands' Nederlandse Financieringsmaatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden (5.0 percent), Compagnie Africaine de Financement et de Participations (10.0 percent) and the privately held African Tiger Mutual Fund Ltd (6.0 percent).
Belgolaise is controlled by Belgium's largest bank, Generale de Banque SA .
